items.title: Require a recorded dev-memory preflight acknowledgement before a story may enter DEV
items.context: Mirrors the existing scope_boundary_set/execution_boundary_set/scope_freeze_check INIT_CHECK-gating pattern. New command (e.g. dev_memory_preflight_ack) writes a JSON artifact under .lattice/story/actives/<id>/ recording that dev_memory_preflight was run and its topHitIds were seen; the DEV-entry gate refuses to advance without this artifact present and bound to the current story's material.

happy.desc: Story in PLAN with no dev-memory-preflight-ack.json artifact -> call dev_memory_preflight_ack -> artifact written -> canStartDevGuard allows PLAN->DEV transition; WHY: confirms the primary happy path (ack exists -> gate opens)

verification.selector: door1 canStartDevGuard (PLAN->DEV): passes after ack is written

happy.desc: evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate returns true when a valid dev-memory-preflight-ack.json exists for the story, regardless of its packDigest/topHitIds content; WHY: existence-only check per plan (not hash/staleness-bound)

verification.selector: CHK-001 edge: evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate reads it back as true regardless of content

happy.desc: getGuardFailureReason for targetPhase=DEV includes missing_dev_memory_preflight_ack tag and actionable run-command hint when ack artifact is absent; WHY: confirms user-visible error message is helpful

verification.selector: door1 canStartDevGuard (PLAN->DEV): getGuardFailureReason tags missing_dev_memory_preflight_ack

edge.desc: Story re-entering DEV from REVIEW (canReenterDevGuard) with ack already present from first PLAN->DEV entry -> gate passes with zero added friction; WHY: ack persists for story lifetime, rollback doors must not re-prompt

verification.selector: door3 canReenterDevGuard (REVIEW->DEV rollback): passes after ack is written

edge.desc: Story skipping PLAN (canSkipPlanGuard) still requires the ack artifact and blocks without it; WHY: all four DEV doors must be gated, not just the PLAN->DEV path

verification.selector: door2 canSkipPlanGuard (INIT_CHECK->DEV express): refuses without dev-memory-preflight-ack.json

edge.desc: dev_memory_preflight_ack writes artifact with correct schema (schemaVersion, storyId, packDigest, topHitIds, acknowledgedAt, acknowledgedBy) and is readable by evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate; WHY: round-trip data integrity

verification.selector: CHK-001 edge: canStartDevGuard passes on the round-tripped ack

adversarial.desc: All four DEV-entry doors (canStartDevGuard, canSkipPlanGuard, canReenterDevGuard from REVIEW, canReenterDevGuard from TEST) block when dev-memory-preflight-ack.json is absent; WHY: adversarial check that gate is wired into EVERY door, not just the primary PLAN->DEV path the story emphasizes

verification.selector: refuses without dev-memory-preflight-ack.json

adversarial.desc: Deleting/truncating dev-memory-preflight-ack.json after it was written -> evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate returns false (fail-closed, treats missing/corrupt as blocking); WHY: prevents bypass via file deletion or corruption

verification.selector: CHK-001 adversarial: re-corrupting after a valid ack blocks again (no caching)

adversarial.desc: dev-memory-preflight-ack.json containing invalid JSON (e.g. truncated, empty object {}, wrong schemaVersion) -> evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate treats it as absent (fail-closed); WHY: a corrupt or hand-crafted artifact must not satisfy the gate

verification.selector: CHK-001 adversarial: truncated/invalid JSON treated as absent (fail-closed)
